idea-plugin.name: E-Invoice Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the wrong values in XRechnung and ZUGFeRD invoice XML while you edit it - offline, nothing uploaded. 31 rules over UBL and CII, each naming the business term and what the receiver will say.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → E-Invoice Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 31 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/einvoice-lint-xrechnung (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/einvoice-lint-xrechnung

action.description: Run E-Invoice Lint on the file in the editor
